reference_sql:
WITH lead_steps AS (  -- one row per lead created in the period, with its opportunity if any
  SELECT l.email, l.source, o.opportunity_id, o.is_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT source,
       COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS contacts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN email END) AS with_opportunity,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_won THEN email END) AS won,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN email END) / COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS opportunity_rate,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_won THEN email END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN email END), 0) AS win_rate,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_won THEN email END) / COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS overall_rate
FROM lead_steps
GROUP BY source
alternatives:
WITH contacts AS (  -- one row per source and email with a 2025 lead, 1 or 0 for each later step
  SELECT l.source, l.email,
         MAX(CASE WHEN o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_opportunity,
         MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE date_part('year', l.created_at) = 2025
  GROUP BY l.source, l.email
)
SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS contacts, SUM(has_opportunity) AS with_opportunity, SUM(has_won) AS won,
       AVG(has_opportunity) AS opportunity_rate,
       1.0 * SUM(has_won) / NULLIF(SUM(has_opportunity), 0) AS win_rate,
       AVG(has_won) AS overall_rate
FROM contacts
GROUP BY source

solver.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT l.source, l.email, BOOL_OR(o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_opp, BOOL_OR(COALESCE(o.is_won, false)) AS is_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY l.source, l.email
),
t AS (
  SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS contacts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_opp) AS with_opportunity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_won) AS won
  FROM c GROUP BY source
)
SELECT source, contacts, with_opportunity, won,
       1.0 * with_opportunity / contacts AS opportunity_rate,
       1.0 * won / NULLIF(with_opportunity, 0) AS win_rate,
       1.0 * won / contacts AS overall_rate
FROM t
